audio.t: Hello, Mr. Dawson, this is Karen Liu from Liu and Park Legal Services, returning your call.
I've reviewed the documents you sent regarding the sale of your warehouse.
Everything looks in order, except that the property survey is more than five years old.
The buyer's attorney will almost certainly ask for a current one, so I recommend ordering a new survey this week.
It usually costs around six hundred dollars and takes about ten days.
If you'd like, my assistant can contact a surveyor for you. Just call our office and press two.

questions.q: Who most likely is the speaker?
questions.explain: Bà giới thiệu mình từ 'Legal Services', xem xét tài liệu bán nhà kho và nhắc 'the buyer's attorney' - bà là luật sư của người bán.

questions.q: What does the speaker recommend?
questions.explain: Bà nói 'I recommend ordering a new survey this week' vì bản khảo sát hiện tại đã hơn năm năm tuổi.

questions.q: What does the speaker offer to do?
options: Have an assistant contact a surveyor
questions.explain: Bà đề nghị 'my assistant can contact a surveyor for you'.

audio.t: Good morning, everyone. Before we begin, I have a few announcements about our new time-tracking system.
Starting next Monday, all staff will log billable hours through the Clockwise application instead of the spreadsheets we've been using.
Training sessions will be held tomorrow and Thursday in the third-floor conference room, and attendance is required.
Also, because of the upgrade, the old spreadsheets will be closed to editing on Friday at five p.m., so please submit your current entries before then.
If you have any questions, please contact Fatima in the technology department.

questions.q: What is the main topic of the announcement?
options: A change in how hours are recorded
questions.explain: Bài nói về hệ thống theo dõi thời gian mới: nhân viên ghi giờ làm qua ứng dụng thay cho bảng tính.

questions.q: What are listeners required to do?
questions.explain: Người nói nhấn mạnh 'attendance is required' cho các buổi đào tạo vào ngày mai và thứ Năm.

questions.q: What will happen on Friday at five p.m.?
options: The old spreadsheets will no longer be editable
questions.explain: Người nói nói bảng tính cũ 'will be closed to editing on Friday at five p.m.'.

audio.t: Are you tired of cooking after a long day? Try Harvest Table Meal Prep and Catering.
Every week, our chefs prepare fresh, balanced dinners using ingredients from local farms.
Choose from twelve menu options, including vegetarian and low-sodium dishes, and pick up your meals on Sunday evening or have them delivered to your door.
New customers who sign up before the end of the month will receive their first week at half price.
Visit our Web site to see this week's menu and place your order.

questions.q: What is being advertised?
questions.explain: Quảng cáo nói đầu bếp chuẩn bị các bữa tối hằng tuần cho khách - dịch vụ chuẩn bị suất ăn (meal prep and catering).

questions.q: What does the speaker say about the ingredients?
questions.explain: Người nói đề cập 'using ingredients from local farms'.

questions.q: How can new customers get a discount?
options: By signing up before the end of the month
questions.explain: Khách mới đăng ký trước cuối tháng sẽ được 'their first week at half price'.

audio.t: Attention, residents of Lakeview Apartments. This is a notice from the building management office.
Next Tuesday, the water supply will be shut off from nine a.m. to one p.m. so that crews can replace a main pipe in the basement.
Please fill containers with drinking water in advance, and avoid using the washing machines in the laundry room during that time.
Hot water may look cloudy for a short time after service is restored. This is harmless and will clear up quickly.
For questions, stop by the management office on the first floor or call extension one hundred.
Thank you for your patience.

questions.q: Why will the water be shut off?
questions.explain: Thông báo nói nước bị cắt 'so that crews can replace a main pipe in the basement'.

questions.q: What are residents asked to do?
questions.explain: Cư dân được nhắc 'fill containers with drinking water in advance' và tránh dùng máy giặt.

questions.q: What does the speaker say about cloudy hot water?
questions.explain: Người nói giải thích nước nóng có thể đục tạm thời nhưng 'This is harmless and will clear up quickly'.

audio.t: Good morning, team. Before we start the shift, I want to go over a few changes at the loading dock.
Beginning today, all forklift drivers must wear high-visibility vests, and pedestrians are not allowed in the yellow lanes while a vehicle is moving.
We've also installed new scanners at bays three and four. Please use them to log every pallet as soon as it comes off the truck.
This will help us locate items more quickly and reduce shipping errors.
Finally, a reminder that the monthly safety meeting is this Friday at two in the break room. Lunch will be provided.

questions.q: Who is the speaker most likely addressing?
questions.explain: Người nói bàn về bến xếp dỡ, xe nâng, pallet và ca làm việc - đối tượng là nhân viên kho.

questions.q: What are workers asked to do at bays three and four?
questions.explain: Người nói bảo 'use them to log every pallet as soon as it comes off the truck' - dùng máy quét ghi nhận mỗi pallet.

questions.q: What will happen on Friday?
options: A safety meeting will take place
questions.explain: Người nói nhắc 'the monthly safety meeting is this Friday at two in the break room'.

audio.t: Welcome to the second day of the Project Leadership Conference.
This morning's keynote will be delivered by Dr. Emily Ross, who has spent twenty years helping companies manage large teams.
After her talk, you'll break into small groups for the workshops. Please check the schedule on the back of your name badge to find your room.
Because of the number of registrations, lunch will be served in two shifts, at twelve and at twelve forty-five.
Finally, if you haven't completed the feedback survey from yesterday, you can do so at the registration desk. Thank you.

questions.q: Where is the announcement most likely being made?
questions.explain: Câu mở đầu 'Welcome to the second day of the Project Leadership Conference' cho biết đây là hội nghị.

questions.q: What are listeners told to check on their name badges?
questions.explain: Người nói bảo 'check the schedule on the back of your name badge to find your room' - phòng workshop.

questions.q: Why will lunch be served in two shifts?
questions.explain: Người nói giải thích 'Because of the number of registrations' - số người đăng ký đông.

audio.t: Hi, this is Marcus from Ironwood Fitness, calling for Ms. Tran.
I'm calling to let you know that your membership will expire on the thirtieth of this month.
As a loyal member, you can renew for a year at a twenty percent discount if you do so before the twentieth.
We're also adding a new swimming pool and a sauna to the second floor next month, and the construction may cause some noise on weekday mornings.
Please call me back or stop by the front desk to renew. Thanks, and have a great day.

questions.q: Why is the speaker calling?
options: To remind a member about a renewal
questions.explain: Anh thông báo thẻ thành viên sắp hết hạn và mời gia hạn ('your membership will expire... you can renew').

questions.q: What will happen if Ms. Tran renews before the twentieth?
options: She will get a free trainer
She will skip the fee for a month
questions.explain: Anh nói gia hạn một năm trước ngày 20 sẽ được 'a twenty percent discount'.

questions.q: What will be added to the gym next month?
questions.explain: Anh nói 'adding a new swimming pool and a sauna to the second floor next month'. Việc thi công có thể gây ồn.

audio.t: Thanks for joining today's product update call.
As you know, our team released version five of the Taskline project management software last week.
Early feedback has been positive, but some customers report that the mobile app crashes when they upload large files.
Our developers have identified the cause and expect to release a fix by Thursday.
In the meantime, I'm asking support staff to suggest using the Web version for uploads.
Please also add this issue to the knowledge base so that customers can find the workaround themselves.

questions.q: What problem do some customers report?
questions.explain: Người nói nói 'the mobile app crashes when they upload large files'.

questions.q: What does the speaker say will happen by Thursday?
options: A new version will be launched
A software fix will be released
questions.explain: Các lập trình viên 'expect to release a fix by Thursday' - bản sửa lỗi.

questions.q: What are support staff asked to tell customers?
questions.explain: Nhân viên hỗ trợ được yêu cầu 'suggest using the Web version for uploads' làm giải pháp tạm.

audio.t: Good afternoon, everyone, and welcome to the Greenfield Community Library construction site.
Before we enter, please put on your helmets and safety glasses, which are in the blue bin by the gate.
The project is about sixty percent complete. The steel frame is finished, and this week the crews are installing windows on the east side.
Because the elevator isn't operational yet, we'll take the stairs to the second floor, so please watch your step.
Photography is allowed, but please don't take pictures of the architect's drawings in the site office.
If you need to leave the group at any time, please let me know.

questions.q: Who most likely are the listeners?
questions.explain: Người nói chào mừng mọi người đến công trường và dặn đội mũ bảo hộ trước khi vào - nhóm khách tham quan.

questions.q: What does the speaker say about the project?
options: It is about sixty percent complete
questions.explain: Người nói nêu 'The project is about sixty percent complete'.

questions.q: Why will the group use the stairs?
options: The elevator is not working yet
questions.explain: Người nói giải thích 'Because the elevator isn't operational yet'.

audio.t: In local business news, Redwood Freight announced today that it will open a new distribution center in Eastport next spring.
The twenty-million-dollar facility is expected to create two hundred jobs, mostly in warehousing and truck driving.
Company president Daniel Moore said the location was chosen for its proximity to the interstate highway and the harbor.
The center will use automated sorting equipment to speed up deliveries to customers across the region.
A job fair will be held at the Eastport Community Hall on the fourteenth. Applicants are asked to bring a résumé.
And now, a look at the weather.

questions.q: What is being announced?
questions.explain: Bản tin nói Redwood Freight 'will open a new distribution center in Eastport next spring'.

questions.q: Why was the location chosen?
options: It is close to a highway and a harbor
questions.explain: Chủ tịch công ty nói địa điểm được chọn vì 'its proximity to the interstate highway and the harbor'.

questions.q: What are job applicants asked to bring to the job fair?
questions.explain: Người dẫn nói 'Applicants are asked to bring a résumé'.
